game.title: Bayonetta
game.notes: Port Mode — sourced from the PS3 native trophy list (51 trophies: 1 Platinum, 2 Gold, 10 Silver, 38 Bronze; Xbox 360 shares the same 50 base achievements). IMPORT: all 51 native entries captured (dossier_scout_native.json). FILTER: dropped 10 granular chapter-range completion trophies (Chapters 1-4/5-7/8-11/12-13/14-Epilogue on Normal and Hard) as redundant slices of Umbra Witch/Umbra Elder/Taste Of The Witching Hour (Rule 20). Also dropped 12 combat-technique trophies whose native condition is a cumulative action count (e.g. 50 Torture Attacks, 20 Wicked Weaves with Dodge Offset, 10 consecutive Witch Time engagements, 10 airborne Kulshedra grabs, 20 enemies frozen with Odette, 20 Concoctions crafted) because the PS3/Xbox achievement systems track these invisible, silently, in the OS — Bayonetta's own in-game UI exposes no equivalent counter for any of them (confirmed via the official Wii U manual's full menu documentation), so a player on Wii U has no way to verify the condition was met (Rule 1/2). The two Alfheim-discovery trophies (discover all 21 / discover half) were dropped for the same reason — no confirmed in-game portal checklist exists — while the Gold trophy for CLEARING all 21 Alfheim challenges was kept, since its completion is independently verifiable through a real, confirmed event: the Lost Chapter: Angel Slayer becoming selectable in Chapter Select. One near-duplicate pair (Nice And Relaxed / Touch And It Will Hurt, both about the Moon of Mahaa-Kalaa accessory) was consolidated by keeping only the 3-consecutive Silver variant, verifiable in the moment without any counter. One trivial one-off (Tread Not So Softly, jump-kill any enemy) was dropped as an arbitrary action with no mastery value (Rule 10). Treasure Collector and Treasure Fanatic were reworded to reference the confirmed, combined Umbran Tears of Blood total (101, tracked directly by the Rarities file per the official Wii U manual) rather than an unconfirmed 'resting places' sub-count, after an audit round caught that distinction wasn't actually supported by any source. PRUNE: no content needed pruning — every scout confirmed the Wii U port is a strict content superset of PS3/360/Steam (extra costumes, Japanese dub, GamePad features), never a subset, so nothing on the native list references content missing from Wii U. COMPLETE: added one original trophy (A Witch of Two Worlds) for the four Nintendo-themed costumes exclusive to the Wii U/Switch releases (Peach, Daisy, Samus, Link), each with real gameplay-affecting quirks, not just cosmetic swaps. Whether Fox McCloud also belongs to this game (rather than being Bayonetta 2-exclusive) was investigated across three separate research passes because sources disagreed. It was ultimately settled against inclusion: a directly-fetched Siliconera article quoting PlatinumGames' own costume announcement states plainly that the Wii U port of the original Bayonetta adds costumes for Peach, Samus, and Link only, and that Fox McCloud is added specifically 'in Bayonetta 2' — a more direct and authoritative source than the ambiguous Wikipedia sentence an earlier pass had relied on. The five boss-defeat trophies were kept at their native Bronze tier (single, self-evident events, no counter needed) per Rule 22's guidance to preserve native tiers unless the target version changes difficulty, which it does not. Per the user's explicit decision, Nintendo Switch differences (an amiibo-scan shortcut that instantly unlocks the same costumes already purchasable with Halos, and nothing else) are documented here rather than built into a separate DLC-style list — there isn't enough distinct Switch-exclusive content to justify one. Two trophies carry lower-confidence wording flagged by research: 'Treasure Collector'/'Treasure Fanatic' verification is inferred to route through the same Rarities file screen that tracks Umbran Tears of Blood, not independently confirmed as a separate screen; and the exact on-screen name of the hardest difficulty (rendered here only as 'the hardest difficulty' rather than quoting a specific string, since sources disagreed between '∞ Climax' and 'Non-Stop Infinite Climax'). One source claimed roughly 15 trophies are marked secret on the native PS3 list, but which specific entries could not be retrieved; only Master Of The Heavens (the Father Balder reveal) is marked secret here, as the one entry with an unambiguous story-spoiler surface — the remaining story trophies (A Primer In The Magical Arts, A Mother's Love, Just In The Nick Of Time, Naughty Tentacles) describe early or mid-game scenes without revealing a plot twist, so they are left visible rather than speculatively hidden.

trophies.name: A Primer In The Magical Arts
trophies.description: Complete the Vestibule.
trophies.verification: The Vestibule tutorial sequence ends and Chapter I begins.
trophies.originId: A Primer In The Magical Arts

trophies.name: A Mother's Love
trophies.description: Defend Cereza during the out-of-body experience, ensuring she takes no damage.
trophies.verification: The scripted defense sequence ends without Cereza having taken damage, confirmed in the moment during the scene.

trophies.name: Just In The Nick Of Time
trophies.description: Dodge the runaway streetcar during Chapter II.
trophies.verification: The scripted streetcar sequence resolves successfully, confirmed in the moment during the scene.
trophies.originId: Just In The Nick Of Time

trophies.name: Naughty Tentacles
trophies.description: Destroy all the tentacles that drop down together during a single sequence in Chapter IX.
trophies.verification: The scripted tentacle sequence resolves with all tentacles destroyed, confirmed in the moment during the scene.

trophies.name: I'm A Bit... I Mean Witch.
trophies.description: Execute a Torture Attack.
trophies.verification: The Torture Attack animation and finisher play out on an enemy, confirmed in the moment.
trophies.originId: I'm A Bit... I Mean Witch.

trophies.name: Wicked Weaver
trophies.description: Execute a Wicked Weave attack while using Dodge Offset.
trophies.verification: The Wicked Weave summon triggers immediately after a Dodge Offset input, confirmed in the moment.

trophies.name: Record Collector
trophies.description: Obtain three complete Angelic Hymn Gold LPs.
trophies.verification: The Rarities file (Game Menu > Item and File > File) shows three Angelic Hymn Gold LPs gathered.

trophies.name: Treasure Collector
trophies.description: Collect roughly half of the game's Umbran Tears of Blood.
trophies.verification: The Rarities file (Game Menu > Item and File > File) shows roughly half of the 101 total Umbran Tears of Blood collected.

trophies.name: Seeker Of Magic
trophies.description: Purchase three new techniques.
trophies.verification: The technique purchase menu at the Gates of Hell shows three techniques owned.

trophies.name: Fortitudo, Bringer Of Flame
trophies.description: Defeat Fortitudo on any difficulty.
trophies.verification: Fortitudo's defeat cutscene plays and Chapter IV proceeds.

trophies.name: Temperantia, Manipulator Of Wind
trophies.description: Defeat Temperantia on any difficulty.
trophies.verification: Temperantia's defeat cutscene plays and Chapter VII proceeds.

trophies.name: Iustitia, Giver Of Life
trophies.description: Defeat Iustitia on any difficulty.
trophies.verification: Iustitia's defeat cutscene plays and Chapter XI proceeds.

trophies.name: Sapientia, Controller Of Seas
trophies.description: Defeat Sapientia on any difficulty.
trophies.verification: Sapientia's defeat cutscene plays and Chapter XIII proceeds.

trophies.name: Master Of The Heavens
trophies.description: Defeat Father Balder on any difficulty.
trophies.verification: Balder's defeat cutscene plays and Chapter XVI resolves into the Epilogue.

trophies.name: Taste Of The Witching Hour
trophies.description: Complete all Chapters on any difficulty.
trophies.verification: The Epilogue: Requiem concludes and the credits roll.

trophies.name: Fire The Afterburners
trophies.description: Earn Platinum Medals during Verse 1 and Verse 2 of Chapter XIV.
trophies.verification: The Chapter XIV clear results screen shows a Platinum medal for both Verse 1 and Verse 2.

trophies.name: Platinum!
trophies.description: Earn a Platinum medal in 10 different Verses.
trophies.verification: Revisiting cleared chapters' results screens shows a Platinum medal recorded on 10 different Verses in total.

trophies.name: Touch And It Will REALLY Hurt
trophies.description: Counter three consecutive enemy attacks with the Moon of Mahaa-Kalaa equipped.
trophies.verification: Three consecutive counters land in a single engagement while the accessory is equipped, confirmed in the moment.
trophies.originId: Touch And It Will REALLY Hurt

trophies.name: Commander Of Magic
trophies.description: Purchase all available techniques.
trophies.verification: The technique purchase menu at the Gates of Hell shows every technique owned.

trophies.name: Record Fanatic
trophies.description: Obtain seven complete Angelic Hymn Gold LPs.
trophies.verification: The Rarities file (Game Menu > Item and File > File) shows seven of the nine Angelic Hymn Gold LPs gathered.

trophies.name: Treasure Fanatic
trophies.description: Collect all 101 Umbran Tears of Blood.
trophies.verification: The Rarities file (Game Menu > Item and File > File) shows all 101 Umbran Tears of Blood collected.

trophies.name: Truth In Its Purest Form
trophies.description: Collect all of Antonio's notes.
trophies.verification: Antonio's Notebook (Game Menu > Item and File > File) shows every note gathered.

trophies.name: Umbra Witch
trophies.description: Complete all Chapters on Normal difficulty.
trophies.verification: Hard difficulty becomes available at the Chapter Menu's difficulty option, confirming Normal was fully cleared.

trophies.name: Umbra Elder
trophies.description: Complete all Chapters on Hard difficulty.
trophies.verification: The hardest difficulty becomes available at the Chapter Menu's difficulty option, confirming Hard was fully cleared.

trophies.name: A Witch of Two Worlds
trophies.description: Unlock all four Nintendo-themed costumes exclusive to this release: Peach, Daisy, Samus, and Link.
trophies.verification: All four costumes appear owned in the wardrobe select screen at the Gates of Hell.

trophies.name: Angel Slayer
trophies.description: Complete all 21 Alfheim Portal challenges.
trophies.verification: Lost Chapter: Angel Slayer becomes selectable from Chapter Select.

trophies.name: Legendary Dark Witch
trophies.description: Complete all Chapters on the hardest difficulty.
trophies.verification: The Epilogue: Requiem concludes and the credits roll while the hardest difficulty is selected.

trophies.name: Non-Stop Infinite Legend
trophies.description: Earn every other trophy.
trophies.verification: All base-game trophies show as earned.
